text: Unlocked Google Pixel 4a not compatible with T-mobile.. At the time of purchase, the unlocked Google Pixel 4a is not compatible with T-Mobile, no matter what the above product information says. I went to two separate T-Mobile stores and confused the hell out of some poor store associates who tried their damndest to get it to work, but they concluded that it just isn't compatible. DO NOT PURCHASE THIS IF YOU HAVE T-MOBILE!

BUYER BEWARE, PHONE IS FOREIGN VERSION OF PIXEL 4a 5G. This is the THIRD time I have tried to purchase the Google Pixel 4a unlocked US version and instead of receiving what was clearly advertised and promised I received a Google Pixel 4a 5G locked Japan version. In the pictures I have green arrows on the Pixel 4a 5G and blue arrows on the Pixel 4a phone. The Google packaging is fairly plain and the differences between the two phones are pretty clear. On the back the 4a has security seals where the 4a 5G version does not. The fine print on the end of the 4a is mainly in English and states it is a Pixel 4a phone while the 4a 5G is almost completely in Japanese characters. Additionally, there is an Avery label clearly mislabeling the 4a 5G phone as a 4a phone.
